title: Japanese Quesadilla Rolls
description: A fusion of Japanese and Mexican flavors, these quesadilla rolls are an interesting twist on traditional sushi.
instructions: Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Place a tortilla in the skillet and sprinkle with sushi rice, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Add a spoonful of quesadilla filling in the center of the rice.
Add sliced chiles on top of the quesadilla filling.
Fold the bottom half of the tortilla up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the tortilla up tightly.
